project_name: VOCIS — AI-Native Customer & Market Intelligence Platform

theme_strategy.aesthetic_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4 + ARCHETYPE 5 Hybrid: Sovereign Intelligence (Deep Obsidian, Architectural Indigo, Tactical Titanium, Signal Emerald/Amber/Rose for Evidence & Trajectory)
theme_strategy.rationale: VOCIS is a high-stakes intelligence weapon for executives, product leaders, and strategists. A pitch-dark or muddy grey theme feels amateur. Instead, VOCIS employs a deep obsidian architectural palette (#07090e base, #0e121b cards, #182030 borders) infused with cool slate subtleties, razor-sharp 1px titanium edges, and controlled kinetic highlights.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-400
hierarchy.evidence_quote: text-sm italic font-normal text-slate-300 border-l-2 border-indigo-500/50 pl-3 py-1

rules: NEVER use generic Inter or pure black for headings. Use high-tracking Plus Jakarta Sans with tight tracking on big sizes.
All metric numbers, priority scores, confidence ratios, and timestamps MUST use font-mono for numerical authority.
Narrative tags (Observation, Context, Evidence, Interpretation, Significance, Implication, Recommended Attention) must use distinct typographic pills with matching high-contrast label badges.

shell_structure.type: Enterprise Left Sidebar + Top Command Bar + Intelligence Workspace Canvas + Right Evidence / Narrative Drawer
shell_structure.sidebar_width: w-64 xl:w-72 border-r border-white/10 bg-[#090c13] shrink-0
shell_structure.topbar_height: h-16 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#07090e]/80 backdrop-blur-md px-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-30
shell_structure.content_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-8

layout_and_grids.bento_strategy: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for Executive Synthesis & Intelligence Hubs. Asymmetric spans with high scannability and immediate drill-down.

section_layouts.executive_overview: Top Executive Synthesis hero banner (col-span-12) + 3 Primary Signal Cards (col-span-4 each: Most Important Finding, What Changed, Recommended Attention) + Priority Issue Matrix (col-span-8) + Temporal Pulse (col-span-4)
section_layouts.customer_intelligence: Theme Semantic Constellation interactive canvas (col-span-7) + Deep Sentiment & Latent Needs breakdown (col-span-5) + Mixed Feedback Dissection table (col-span-12)
section_layouts.product_intelligence: Product Strengths vs Friction radar/bars + Feature gap matrix + Per-product narrative cards with evidence links
section_layouts.competitive_intelligence: Dynamic Dimension Comparison Matrix (Strong / Medium / Weak pills with hover rationale) + Market Displacement Signals
section_layouts.market_intelligence: Web & Market Industry Signals clearly demarcated with 'External Market Intelligence' badge vs 'Customer Feedback Evidence'
section_layouts.evidence_explorer: Filter Command Bar (sentiment, themes, intent, severity, product, search) + Density-optimized feedback stream with Quick Quote & Deep Inspector drawer
section_layouts.strategic_intelligence: Synthesis & Strategic Horizons + Priority Attention Matrix + Actionable Bets with ROI & Risk projections
section_layouts.reports: Professional Intelligence Dossier Generator + Export View (Markdown / PDF Preview) with Executive Summary, Methodology, and Citation Footnotes

visual_enhancers.surface_treatment: Crystal glass headers with backdrop-blur-xl and delicate 1px border-white/10. Cards have a 1px border with layered ambient drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.subtle_3d_depth: Dimensional card tilt on hover (using subtle CSS perspective or Framer Motion rotateX/rotateY under 3 degrees), interactive 2.5D Semantic Constellation nodes using SVG/Canvas with glow filters, depth-layered badges.
visual_enhancers.tactical_badges: High-contrast micro badges with font-mono uppercase labels, status dots with soft breathing glow.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Graceful degradation when a section lacks data: architectural blueprint icon, clear context explaining what data source is needed, and a 1-click 'Load Sample Industry Benchmark Dataset' CTA.

rules: No bouncy spring animations or fast spin cycles. Use controlled bezier cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ease-out.
Card expansions must use smooth height/opacity transitions (Framer Motion AnimatePresence).
Drawer slider: slides from right with blur overlay backdrop (z-50).
Hover states: Subtle translate-y-[-2px] with border-white/25 enhancement.

Multi-step Upload/Ingestion experience: progressive steps ('Analyzing Schemas', 'Disseminating Semantics', 'Correlating Issues', 'Synthesizing Intelligence') with animated progress bars and live status log.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element, tab, filter, button, metric card, and modal trigger MUST have a distinct data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build VOCIS using React with Tailwind and Lucide-React / Radix components.

Implement the two levels of information in every intelligence section: 'Quick Intelligence' (crisp KPI badges, urgency meters, high-contrast summaries) and 'Deep Intelligence' (full narrative chain: Observation -> Context -> Evidence -> Interpretation -> Significance -> Implication -> Recommended Attention).

Ensure the Evidence Drawer can slide out from any insight card when clicking 'View Evidence (N citations)', displaying verbatim customer reviews with highlights, sentiment badges, customer segment, and timestamps.

Provide high quality pre-loaded mock datasets (e.g. Enterprise Cloud ERP, B2B SaaS Workflow, FinTech Mobile App) with instant toggle, while enabling a real CSV upload pipeline with schema recognition, simulated AI clustering, and stateful ingestion.
Provide responsive desktop & tablet layout with sticky sidebar and fluid scroll areas. Avoid any pure white blinding cards in dark mode.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Never use rainbow gradients, 100% border radiuses on massive cards, or excessive decorative emojis. Use architectural 1px borders, subtle slate glows, and font-mono data tags.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces is minimum text-slate-300 or text-white for headlines, and text-slate-400 for secondary body.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.dropdown_rule: NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or drawers. Always use solid or heavy backdrop-blur (#0f141f / #151b29).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.performance: Render semantic nodes and lists with React memoization and clean subgrid or flex structures.
